ITEM 1 | Flatbread wedge with golden-brown, blistered crust edge, topped with red tomato sauce and melted white cheese with light browning spots; triangular slice about 12 cm long and 6 cm wide at the crust, sitting at the lower-left edge of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Plain white long-grain rice, fluffy separate grains with slight moisture and no sheen, mounded in a pile about 9 cm across and 2 cm high on the right-center of the plate, with a few loose grains scattered nearby | 150
ITEM 3 | Small dark green-brown brussels-sprout-like halves and quarters, glossy and slightly charred, some with browned outer leaves, clustered in a group about 6 cm by 5 cm at the upper-right of the plate | 60
ITEM 4 | Yellow-gold potato chunks, roughly 2.5 cm pieces with cut faces showing, soft-looking, slightly glossy with light browning and a yellow-olive seasoning tint, arranged in a band about 9 cm long along the right side | 70
ITEM 5 | Dark green curved pieces resembling sliced zucchini or cucumber skin, glossy and slightly wilted, about 3 cm long, two or three pieces near the potatoes | 12
ITEM 6 | Single dark olive-green wilted leaf, flat and slightly curled, about 3 cm long, lying alone in the upper-middle of the plate | 2
